subject: [PATCH 11/22] mm/mempolicy: don't NUMA-hint folios outside common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NUMA balancing scanner to not inject hint faults or migrate folios that are outside of common memory, which includes zone device memory. The existing check for zone device memory is replaced with a more general check for common memory. As all memory is considered common at this point, the behavior remains unchanged.
